decision.reason: [ev-5506a0d4614a] is a single Bug Fixes line, "bottlerocket settings taint format (#6489)". It does not describe the format before or after the fix, which setups were affected, or what an operator sees, and three of the four proposals left the consequence undetermined for this reason. The proposed behavior-change statement (taints are written in a corrected format and nodes get differently formatted settings) goes beyond the excerpt. The excerpt does not say whether taints were previously ignored or rejected, or were applied but formatted differently. Deciding the consequence would need the PR #6489 description or diff showing the bug and its effect on Bottlerocket nodes.
